sequence_rule.violation: provide_solution occurs before assess_need is complete
sequence_rule.output: You presented a solution at {timestamp}, before you confirmed what they needed.

stages.name: Engage and build the relationship
checks: Rapport established before any transactional talk
Asked how they found you or who referred them
Learned something personal about their situation

stages.name: Qualify the prospect
checks: Motivation: why are they moving, is it forced or optional
Timeline: a specific date or trigger, not 'sometime'
Financing readiness: pre-approved, cash, or lender named
Decision makers: who else is involved and are they present
Current situation: own or rent, must they sell first

stages.name: Assess and confirm need
checks: Separated must-haves from nice-to-haves
Reflected the need back in their own words
Got an explicit yes confirming the need is correct

stages.name: Present capabilities and confirm trust
checks: Local track record or comparable clients cited specifically
Explained their process and what happens next
Raised the buyer representation and compensation conversation

stages.name: Provide solution
checks: Recommendation maps explicitly to the confirmed need
Addressed the constraints raised during qualify

stages.name: Confirm commitment
checks: A specific next step with a date, not 'I'll send some listings'
Both parties stated what they will do
Agreement or next meeting actually scheduled

stages.name: Serve customer
checks: Follow-up promised with a timeframe
Expectations set for cadence of contact

constraints.tone: Findings are missed opportunities, never mistakes or grades. No scores.
